source_instruction: i am looking for a multi-colored blackout window film for my living room.
query: Oh man, I spent my whole morning trying to get my sourdough starter to stop smelling like old gym socks, I think I fed it too much whole wheat flour yesterday and it went totally feral. My neighbor dropped off a jar of pickled okra that’s so briny it made my eyes water when I took a bite, and I still haven’t figured out why my houseplant keeps growing those weird fuzzy brown spots no matter how much I adjust the sun. Also, I saw a squirrel steal an entire bagel off my fire escape this morning and it just sat on the railing staring at me like I was the rude one for being upset. Anyway, I’m looking at window coverings right now, I need ones suitable for a formal dining room, I want the multi-13124 option, and my budget is $40 max.
